thread:
marta: Quick sync — I'm prepping the registry entry for the new zeta-13b variant. Where are the canonical weights right now? Need to run checksum + tokenizer sanity before we onboard.

ben: S3 has the current copy: s3://redwood-artifacts/incoming/zeta-13b/v1/weights.tar.zst. HF also has a mirror at hf://redwood/zeta-13b-v1 but last I checked the HF mirror was missing the shard-0003 file.

kavi: Right — HF mirror was started but the final shard failed due to a transient timeout. I retried once and it's pending. If you need immediate access use the S3 path.

marta: Got it. Ben, can you confirm the checksum (sha256) for weights.tar.zst and upload a manifest with digests? We need the digest in registry.json before the manifest PR.

ben: Running checksum now. I can push a manifest to s3://redwood-artifacts/manifests/zeta-13b/v1/manifest.json. Will include fields: source: s3, sha256, size_bytes, origin: team/eng-ml, tokenizer_hint.

alice: Heads up on tokenizer: this model's tokenizer is a hybrid BPE file (vocab.json + merges.txt) but the hf repo has an extra tokenizer.json that maps legacy special tokens differently. When you validate, compare token ids for <pad>, <eos>, <bos>. I found an off-by-one mapping earlier.

marta: Important — if tokenizer ids differ we break kv-cache alignment. Can you dump the mapping? Small snippet would help.

alice: Sure. Quick inspect command: 
```
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json'); print({k:v for k,v in t.get_vocab().items() if k in ['<pad>','<eos>','<bos>']})"
```
That prints ids for the special tokens. For the BPE files use huggingface transformers' PreTrainedTokenizerFast.from_pretrained(path).

kavi: Also note: registry validation rejects manifest if presigned URLs expire in <48h. When you upload manifest, put TTL=72h for origin links. Our artifact-guard will recheck accessibility.

infra-bot: artifact-guard: manifest at s3://redwood-artifacts/manifests/zeta-13b/v1/manifest.json queued for validation (job id: ag-17905-11). Checks: checksum, presign_ttl>=48h, tokenizer_hint present.

ben: Checksum: sha256=7f3d2b9d4a6c9f1a58e2b6d2b9f9a3c4d2e8b6c1a5f2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e, size_bytes=1432172800. Pushed manifest with presigned_url ttl=72h. Link: s3://redwood-artifacts/manifests/zeta-13b/v1/manifest.json

marta: Thanks. Alice — can you run the token id check and paste results? If ids mismatch we'll add a conversion step to the onboarding pipeline.

alice: Ran it quickly. BPE files report {'<pad>': 0, '<eos>': 2, '<bos>': 1}. tokenizer.json on HF had {'<pad>': 1, '<eos>': 2, '<bos>': 0}. So pad/bos swapped.

leo: @marta @ben FYI I'll add a small transform to registry ingestion: if tokenizer_hint=="bpe-legacy-swap" apply swap mapping and record mapping in provenance. I'll open a tiny PR to manifest-processor. Ping me for CR.

marta: Sounds good. Can you also add a note to the manifest: "tokenizer_transform: swap_pad_bos" so downstream infra knows an on-the-fly remap occurred?

leo: Yep. PR incoming in ~20m. I'll include tests that assert decode/encode roundtrip for special tokens. :eyes:

infra-bot: artifact-guard: validation passed for manifest ag-17905-11 — checksum match, presign_ttl OK, tokenizer_hint present. Marking as ready-for-onboard.

marta: Great. Next steps: leo's PR merged -> registry ingestion run -> smoke run on dedicated staging (short prompt + kv-cache run). Ben please coordinate a brief canary run and post logs here.

ben: Will do. Scheduling canary on dedicated-staging gpu-pool at 1820 UTC. I'll share logs.

marta: Thanks team. Closing the loop here — update the PR links once merged and I'll flip the onboarding flag. :thumbsup:
